failure_correlation.root_cause: In commit 2291fb1940ae60cab89c743f4cd3047a45c75ae7 (PR #929 FE-MGMT-CATALOG-LEGIBILITY-20261105), src/platform/components/LineageGraph.tsx:185 localized the >500-node server-layout threshold warning via t('lineage.overServerNotice', { count: nodes.length, limit: LINEAGE_NODE_LIMITS.serverLayoutThreshold }). In zh-TW (src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts:841, the default locale in src/i18n/index.ts when localStorage 'pantheon.locale' is unset), this renders '血緣圖共 506 個節點（超過 500），需改用伺服器端分群摘要檢視。' (and in en-US at src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts:856 renders 'This lineage has 506 nodes (more than 500). Use the server-side clustered summary view instead.'). e2e/18-perf.spec.ts:1212 and 1218 still waited for / asserted the obsolete pre-localization English literal '/Lineage has 506 nodes \(> 500\); server-side layout \/ clustered summary required\./i'.

changes: Updated only the 'warns when LineageGraph receives more than 500 nodes' test in e2e/18-perf.spec.ts to retire the stale literal '/Lineage has 506 nodes/i' and '/Lineage has 506 nodes \(> 500\); server-side layout \/ clustered summary required\./i'.

Resolved the configured locale from window.localStorage.getItem('pantheon.locale') || 'zh-TW' using the existing contained loopback and locale setup, and asserted exact visibility of the full current localized warning with 506 nodes and the 500-node server-layout threshold ('血緣圖共 506 個節點（超過 500），需改用伺服器端分群摘要檢視。' for zh-TW; 'This lineage has 506 nodes (more than 500). Use the server-side clustered summary view instead.' for en-US).

Preserved the 506-node fixture, canonical /bff/lineage request counter assertion (counters.lineage > 0), zero page/console error assertion (failures === []), and all other F18 performance budgets and assertions unchanged.
